cases.comparison_scope: Per window, all arms restore identical adapters and share identical inputs/labels. GA2 duplicates GA1 before any update. Only successful GA1 advances the next common window start; no cross-arm divergent optimizer trajectories are compared.

precision_evidence.adapter_initialization_policy: Existing streamed PEFT initialization, then unchanged b13_moe_fixture.randomize_adapters(seed=67), B and embedding factors only

admission.kind: fixed conservative admission, not measured tensor attribution
admission.includes: tiny checkpoint/twins, input schedule, decoder diagnostic clones and scratch

resident.on_request_failure: restore previous native attention config, record error
resident.executed_path: not inferred from config; driver counts SDPA calls

streamed.on_request_failure: restore previous native attention config, record error
streamed.executed_path: not inferred from config; driver counts SDPA calls

fp8_decoder_gates.scope: first full window, including maximum sequence length; not all windows

cases.short_final_note: k=1 has no nonempty shorter final window

gpu.name: Tesla T4
gpu.throughput_claim: No native-BF16 hardware throughput claim; inspect observed dtypes

scope_note: No forced routes, no candidates selected, baseline and storage gates separate
